ruling.scope: Ben ruled on 2026-09-06 at 11:07, in his words: "do it". PR 236 ships the pin-history ledger that PROVENANCE.txt already promises. TWO protected artifacts appear in the range and they are NOT equal in kind. FIRST, wasm-spike/verified/pin-history.json is the real change Ben approved: a 55-line ledger recording each assurance-kit commit with its kernel sha256 and its status. SECOND, test/fixtures/readme-demo-checker-output.txt is a TOUCH AND REVERT with ZERO net change. I verified that on disk: its blob is 91368ba4838472067d3d80ec2f74cef4d196bbd5 on origin/main AND at this head, so the two are byte-identical, and git diff between them prints nothing. The gate reports it only because it walks every commit in the range rather than the net tree, which is deliberate so an add-then-delete cannot disappear from review. It must appear in this record because the checker requires the recorded file set to equal the changed set exactly. CORRECTION I OWE BEN: I told him PR 236 needed ONE protected-path ruling. Two artifacts are reported. Only one of them actually changes, and I checked that before writing this rather than after.
retires: The 2026-09-05 ruling on test/fixtures/readme-demo-checker-output.txt and test/fixtures/readme-demo-output.txt, base 517e212f280d188631d1219bc223008cd097ffae. That ruling covered a different base and a different branch.
